title: Engineered clay pellets functionalized with industrial residuals for phosphorus removal from agricultural runoff
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00880H, Paper
Rajpreet Kaur, Mandeep Singh Bakshi, Michael Holly
Naturally occurring Ca-bentonite and kaolinite clay minerals acted as low-cost adsorbents for removing phosphorus (P) from waste water and soil.
